tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sangs rgyas thod pa'i cho ga sa ra ha'i zhal lung dkyil chog dang bcas pa bklag chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so//

༄༅// sangs rgyas thod pa sna tshogs sde yi 'od// phang par 'khril ba he ru ka kun gyi// gtsug tu mchod der phyag byas rigs kyi mes// sa ra ha pa'i zhal lung 'di bzhin bsgo// rnal 'byor pa bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid las byung ba'i gshin rje mche ba la sogs pa'i lha mos bskor ba'i sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs nas oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza kha hi/ zhes bdud rtsi lngas yang dag par mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don gnyis rab sgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog/ ces bdun rnam dag bya/ tshogs kyi zhing bdag nyid la thim par bsam/ de nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig/ sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐/ de nas lte 'og gi rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis sbar bas 'od zer spros pas lus thams cad bsregs/ de'i ngang las raṃ las nyi ma/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje nag po dpag tu med pa spros/ rdo rje'i ra ba dang drwa ba rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ de'i dbus su e gru gsum gyi cha byad can chos kyi 'byung gnas/ de'i dbus su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gnyis dang yaṃ gyis mtshan pa/

des rtsa rnams bskyod pas 'khor lo thams cad thim bzhin pa'i dbus su/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar ba bdun dang raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ rtsa bco brgyad kyi gnas nas 'dzag bzhin pa/ de'i dbus su baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa dang baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ rtsa'i 'khor lo thams cad chu'i dkyil 'khor la thim pa/ de'i dbus su laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rdo rje dang laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi snam bu bcu gcig pas brgyan pa mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa rgyan gyis legs par spras pa'i dbus su padma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba mthing*/ phyogs dkar ser dmar ljang*/ mtshams ci mdzes pa de'i phyir 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dmar po rtsibs mchan ljang kha/ de'i phyir rtsibs brgyad dkar po rtsibs mchan nag po/ rim pa gsum po mu khyud rdo rje sngon po dang padma dmar po dang rdo rje dkar pos byas pa/ lte ba'i dbus su chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid kyi ro/ de'i steng du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ tshar gnyis yongs su gyur pa'i zla ba me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ tshar gnyis yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma mnyam nyid ye shes/ de gnyis kyi dbus su hūm̐ shes rab dang thabs so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje'i lte ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bya grub ye shes/ de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las he ru ka sangs rgyas thod pa sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon na thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ hūm̐ zhes sgrog cing skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa 'jigs shing khro ba'i bdag nyid stag gi pags pa'i na bza' mnabs pa/

mgo rlon bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya drug dang dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lngas brgyan cing*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog nag po can/ gtso bo'i shes rab chen mo sna tshogs bde ma dkar mo zhal shin tu 'gyur ma/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pas 'jigs pa/ g.yas na ḍā ma ru 'chang zhing gri gug brdeg pa'i tshul/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba'i rgyun 'dzag pa yab la stob cing kha ṭwāṃ ga gru mo la gzer ba/ gcer bu rgyan dang bral ba/ skra grol ba/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis yab dang 'khril ba/ gnyis ka'ang 'od kyi 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i klong na bzhugs pa/ hūm̐ nyi shu rtsa bzhi las skad cig gis/ shar gyi 'dab mar 'phreng bzang ma dkar mo/ byang du 'od can ma ser mo/ nub tu 'jigs ma dmar mo/ lhor thub dka' ma nag mo/ mtshams bzhir bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa bzhi/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i rtsibs la dge ba'i ska rags ma dang*/ gzugs can ma dang*/ rnam rgyal ma dang*/ byed ma rnams phyogs la/ thod pa can dang*/ mtsho chen ma dang*/ rgyud byed ma dang*/ gsod byed ma rnams dmar mo mtshams la/ sku'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs la/ sgrol byed ma dang*/ 'jigs ma dang*/ lā ma dang*/ mi phaṃ ma rnams phyogs dang*/ dge ma dang*/ 'jur byed ma dang*/ dus mtshan ma dang*/ drag chen ma mtshams/ de rnams dkar mo phyogs shar nas g.yon/ mtshams dbang ldan nas g.yas skor du/ de thams cad nyi ma la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa/ shar sgor mdzes ma dkar mo/ byang sgor nor 'dzin ma ser mo/ nub sgor skal bzang ma dmar mo/ lho sgor grags mthong ma nag mo/ nyi ma dang ro'i steng du g.yon brkyangs pa'i zhabs kyis gnas pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa stag gi pags pas sked pa dkris shing rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer rnon po gtibs pa/ skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba/

kha nas khrag 'thor ba khu ba dang ldan pa/ zhes gsal thebs pa dang*/ lha mo nyi shu rtsa bzhis mchod nas/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi lnga gsol bar gyur/ de nas sna tshogs bde ma'i padma la āḥ he ru ka'i rdo rje la hūm̐/ yab yum rdo rje padma sbyor ba mdzad nas lha mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi la 'dod pa spyad cing chags pa chen po la shin tu chags pas gtso bo yab yum zhu bar gyur nas nyi ma'i dbus su khu bar gnas pa la/ byams pa la sogs pa'i rang bzhin sgo srung ma rnams kyis rim pa bzhin glus bskul ba/ ci ste 'jig rten snyan mnan na// ci phyir khyod ni mi dgyes 'gyur// gal te khyod bdag tshig gsan na// mi dgyes gyur pa mtha' dag thong*// dang*/ stong pa'i gzugs ni ma mdzad par// nyid kyi dgongs pa grags par mdzod// srid 'jigs skye bo kun bslu bas// rnal 'byor ma yi grogs po bzhengs// dang*/ sngon gtso gal te tshig gsan na// bya ba yal bar ma dor cig /khyod mi snang na 'gro ba kun// lhung bar gyur pas mi dgar 'gyur// dang*/ log pa'i nga rgyal ma mdzad par// grags pas stong pa'i rang bzhin mthong*// dngos po mtha' dag khyod thong la// rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs la spyod// zhes glus bskul ma thag tu/ khu ba'i gzugs las a dang hūm̐ de gnyis las gri gug dang rdo rje/ de las he ru ka sangs rgyas thod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon na thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ hūm̐ zhes sgrog cing skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa 'jigs shing khro ba'i bdag nyid stag gi pags pa'i na bza' mnabs pa/ mgo rlon bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya drug dang dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lngas brgyan cing*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog nag po can/ gtso bo'i shes rab chen mo sna tshogs bde ma dkar mo zhal shin tu 'gyur ma/

mche ba cung zad gtsigs pas 'jigs pa/ g.yas na ḍā ma ru 'chang zhing gri gug brdeg pa'i tshul/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba'i rgyun 'dzag pa yab la stob cing kha ṭwāṃ ga gru mo la gzer ba/ gcer bu rgyan dang bral ba/ skra grol ba/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis yab dang 'khril ba/ gnyis ka'ang 'od kyi 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i klong na bzhugs pa/ snying gar oṃ/ dpral bar hām̐/ spyi gtsug tu hai/ཾ dpung pa gnyis su hauṃ/ mig gnyis su heṃ/ gsang bar hoṃ/ lus thams cad du haṃ/ snying gar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje/ snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu/ oṃ buddhā ka pā la ni a/ khaṃ graṃ bhrūṃ bhruṃ aḥ.aḥ.aḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces 'gyings pa dang bcas pas bzlas pas ye shes sems dpa' bkug dam tshig sems dpa' la bcug pas chu dang 'o ma ltar 'dres/ de ltar dpa' bo rdzogs pa/ de nas rtsa'i 'khor lo las byang chub kyi sems 'dzag pa de las rnal 'byor ma rnams sna tshogs pa'i snying rje chen mo dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab pa/ gos sna tshogs gyon pa/ lang tshos brgyan pa'i rnal 'byor ma brgyad nam mkhar gnas pa bum pa byang chub sems kyis yongs su gang ba a mra'i shing los kha brgyan pa re thogs pa/ rab tu dwangs shing bzhad pa'i zhal gyis rgyal gyur he ru ka /zhes smra ba de mthong nas dbang bskur zhu ba'i phyir gsol ba gdab pa/ brtse ldan grags pa chen po yis// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbang bskur// 'khor ba'i 'dam du 'bying ba bdag /dbang bskur ba yis de sgrol zhig/ bum dbang*/ ji ltar bu tsha med pa'i khyim// shi ma thag tu stong par 'gyur// de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni// ye shes kun gyis stong par 'gyur// gsang dbang*/ ji ltar pi wang sbyor kun tshogs// rgyud dang bral na brdung mi rung*// de ltar dbang dang bral na ni// sngags dang bsam gtan 'grub mi 'gyur//

dbang gsum pa/ rmongs pa gang zhig dbang med par// bdag ni dbang bskur zhes smra ba// ji ltar sangs rgyas bzhugs kyi bar// slob mar bcas te dmyal bar 'gro// de ltar mkhyen mdzod rnal 'byor ma// slar yang bdag la dbang bskur stsol// gal te dbang bskur skye med na// he ru ka ru bdag 'gyur ci// de nas rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis rgyal gyur rgyal gyur zhes pas bcom ldan 'das la sogs pa la khrus gsol zhing phyi dang gsang bar bcas pa'i dbang bskur ba tsam gyis nam mkha'i ngos nas rnga'i sgra grag cing tsandan dang me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro// dbang bskur zin nas rnal 'byor ma rnams rtsa'i 'khor lo la thim/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab par gyur/ de nas glu'i bstod pa gang yin ma 'tshal dang*/ snying kha'i rtsa 'dab brgyad las byung ba'i rnal 'byor ma brgyad kyis gtso bo la mchod par bsam la/ oṃ buddhā ka pā la ni pra war satka ra badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ sngags thog mtha' 'dra bas/ oṃ badzra puṣpe pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ dhu pe= ā lo ke= gandhe= nai wi dya= shapta pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ ces mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i rnam lnga rol mo dang bcas pa/ oṃ āḥbadzra rū pa pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin/ shapta= gandhe= rā sye= sparshe pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ bcas 'dod pa lnga la sogs pa'i mchod pa dang*/ bdud rtsi/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las thod pa/ de'i nang du bi mu ra su ma las bdud rtsi lnga/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ rlung gis me sbar/ mes thod pa bsros/ rdo rje'i rnam pa lta bu'i rlangs pa 'thon/ yang bsil bar bya ba'i phyir te/ mtho gang tsam du yaṃ gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin oṃ gyis byin gyis brlabs pa de las kha ba lta bu'i bdud rtsi babs pas bsil bar gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas lha rnams kyis myangs pas tshim par bsam mo// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rtag tu rmi lam dang sgyu ma lta bur bsgom par bya'o// de nas rdzogs pa'i rim par bshad pa bzhin kyang bsgom zhing skyo na sngags kyi bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ hrīḥbuddhā hūm̐/ ka pā la ni a/ rtsa ba'i sngags/ 'jug pa la oṃ/ dbyung ba la hrīḥ gnas pa la buddhā/ bde ba la hūm̐/ nub pa la ka pā li ni/ ldang ba la a'o// de ltar yan lag drug gis nang gi bdag nyid kyi sngags bzlas par bya'o// 'di nyid la goms pa'i sbyor bas sangs rgyas su 'gyur te gzhan du ma yin no// oṃ buddha ka pā li ni a hrīḥhe hūm̐ phaṭ/ snying po/ oṃ ka pā la badzri ni hūm̐/ he du rakṣe hūm̐ phaṭ/ nye snying ngo*// dkyil 'khor bdag po'i bzlas pa ni/ bsod nams che 'bring chung ba dag /bye ba 'bum dang khris 'grub 'gyur// 'khor rnams gtso bo'i yan lag phyir// tha dad par ni bzlas mi bya// zhes so// de nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bdag nyid kyi snying gar bsdus/ swa bhā wa 'i sngags brjod/ stong pa nyid raṃ las nyi ma la hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de las rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba dang bcas pa'i gur sa gzhi/ de'i dbus su skad cig gis sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyer lnga pa'i dkyil 'khor khams gsum gyi 'byung po ma lus pas bskor bar gsal ba'i mdun du bdag nyid gtso bo gnas bdun go chas brgyan par bsam/ gtor ma/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las thod pa/ de'i nang du bi mu ra su ma las bdud rtsi lnga/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ rlung gis me sbar/ mes thod pa bsros/ rdo rje'i rnam pa lta bu'i rlangs pa 'thon/ yang bsil bar bya ba'i phyir te/ mtho gang tsam du yaṃ gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin oṃ gyis byin gyis brlabs pa de las kha ba lta bu'i bdud rtsi babs pas bsil bar gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan bdun bzlas pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par spros/ oṃ buddhā ka pā la ni a/ khaṃ graṃ bhrūṃ bhruṃ aḥ.aḥ.aḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bskul bas bsgoms pa lta bu'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo dang*/ 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad bkug nas dam tshig pa la thim/ gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ buddha ka pā li ni dāe wa maṇḍal badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ badzra puṣpe pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ ljags rdo rje sbu gu can du gyur pa'i rtse mor oṃ/ de'i 'od zer gyis drangs nas gsol bar bsam/ 'khor lo gsum la/ oṃ buddha ka pā li ni ba liṃ gṛ hṇa gṛ hṇa gṛ hṇa pa ya gṛ hṇa pa ya kha khā hūm̐/ 'khor gyi 'byung po rnams la/ oṃ buddhāt+s+ma ka pā la badzra tsi tre su tsi tre/ a laṃ ba ne/ prī ṇā ya/ sarba bhū tān/྄ mā ra ya sarba mā ra na/ kī la ya sarba duṣṭān/ utstsha ṭa ya/ sarba bighnān/྄ bi ṭa wā ya/ bho bha ga wa te/ yakṣa rakṣa sa/ pi shā tsa na/ sho ṣa ya/ tā ḍa ya/ sapta pā tā la ga tā na/ sa ra sa ra/ pra sa ra pra sa ra/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/

lan gsum gyis phul tshim par bsam mo// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// bzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// 'on te skyob pa'i sras su skye// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdig med pa'i// sangs rgyas nyid dang 'phrad gyur cig /lam de nyid la zhugs nas kyang*// ma grol ba rnams grol bar shog /ma brgal ba rnams brgal bar shog /rnal 'byor gtsug lag dam tshig la// da lta nyid du gnas par shog/ lag pa brkyang ste sa la bzhag se gol lan gsum brdabs nas dril bu dkrol te gshegs su gsol lo// de nas spyod lam la 'jug bsnyen pa'o// ༈ da ni dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bshad par bya ste/ dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas su phyi'i dkyil 'khor bri ba'i don du maṇḍal la dri dang bdud rtsi bran te/ lha grangs kyi tshom bu byas/ mchod pas mtha' bskor te/ tshogs bsags nas bzung bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas song ba'i rjes su tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi gzhir raṃ las nyi ma/ de'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje sogs nas rtsa rnams bzhag bdag nyid kyi ro/ dbus su yi ge hūm̐ las dpal he ru ka sangs rgyas thod pa sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa sogs nas 'khor dang bcas pa rgyu dus lta/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa'i bar/ oṃ buddhā ka pā la ni pra war satka ra badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ sogs mchod yon sngon du 'gro bas rnam lnga rol mo dang bcas pa/ 'dod pa lnga la sogs pas mchod pa dang*/ bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar bdag bskyed skabs bzhin gyis mchod/ rdo rje dang ni padma 'dus shing bdud rtsis bde rgyas shing*// rim gyis yongs gyur sku can sems can don du gar byed pa// rdo rje lha mo'i rtsed mo rol pas rtser mdzod 'gro rmongs la// 'gro la mi dman kun dga' ster ba khyod la bdag 'dud do//

zhes bstod/ sangs rgyas thams cad bdag la dgongs// khyod rnams mchod pa'i phyir dang ni// slob ma rnams la bdag cag rnams la phan pa yis// sangs rgyas thod pa zhes bya ba'i// dkyil 'khor bzang po bri bar 'tshal// bdag la byin gyis brlab par mdzod// ces gsol ba gdab/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo brkyang ba rtse sprad pa spyi bor 'og tu phyogs par bzhag la/ hūm̐ badzrod tiṣṭha/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ zhes mos/ de nas lag pa mnyam bzhag las g.yas sa la lan gsum brdabs pas/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis rin po che'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa lte ba yan chad sa gseb nas 'thon pa ci bgyi zhes brjod pa gsal bar gyur/ de la/ pri thi bī de wī arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā dyāṃ= puṣpe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gandhe= nai wi dyā= shapta= gtor ma nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas brlabs la/ oṃ a kā ro sa gtor ma 'bul/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// he ru ka dpal dpa' bo yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las// rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri// zhes pa'i bar lan gsum brjod pas/ lha mo de dga' ba'i mdangs kyis// khyod ni slob dpon yin pas na// dkyil 'khor mchog gi las gyis shig /ces gnang ba byin nas sa de nyid du thim par gyur/ de nas/ snying ga'i hūm̐ yig gi 'od zer gyis bye brag gi sa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa ā karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas bkug bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a ka ro sa gtor ma byin/ sa phyogs gnas pa'i lha dang klu// gnod sbyin dri za lha ma yin// gang dag rdzu 'phrul che ldan pa// rdo rje spyan dang snyan mnga' ba// bdag ming che ge mo rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni zhes pa// bde gshegs rnams la mchod pa dang*// sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir// dge ba'i sa phyogs de nyid du// dkyil 'khor dam pa cher 'byung ba// sangs rgyas thod pa rgyud rgyal gyi// dkyil 'khor chen po'i las byed pas// khyod kyis bar chad ma byed par// dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod//

lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ ci dga' ba gyis shig ces dga' ba'i gnang ba byin/ badzra muḥrang gnas su gshegs/ tshom bu dang mchod rdzas bsdu/ sa bslang ba'o// der slob dpon rgyan drug sogs kyis brgyan te khri'u'i khar 'dug phyogs su slob ma rnams bkod/ rang gi snying khar a las zla ba'i steng du sogs tshogs zhing nas bzlas pa grub pa'i bar dang*/ gtor ma/ swa bhā wa 'i sngags brjod/ stong pa nyid raṃ las nyi ma sogs nas gshegs su gsol ba'i bar gyis gtor ma btang ba bcas sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ de nas phyogs bzhir gnas pa'i slob ma rnams kyis/ rang nyid skad cig gis shar nas phreng bzang ma dkar mo/ byang nas thod pa can ser mo/ nub nas 'jigs byed ma dmar mo/ lho nas thub dka' ma nag mo/ thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin cing 'dzum khro sgegs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ nyi ma'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang*/ phyogs kyi gos can kha nas khrag 'thor zhing khu ba dang ldan pa'o// mchod rdzas rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod rdzas rnams a las thod pa'i snod rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ re re zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ 'thor 'thung*/ me tog bdug pa/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa rnam pa lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad/ ngo bo stong nyid/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed nus pa rnams su gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ pā dyaṃ= prokṣa ṇaṃ= puṣpe nas/ shapta 'i bar du sbyar te byin gyis brlabs/ mchod pa'i tshig 'phreng gang 'os rgyas par spel ba'am/ bsdu na/ oṃ buddhā ka pā la ni pra war satka ra badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/

oṃ buddhā ka pā la ni badzra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā// de bzhin du/ prokṣa ṇaṃ= oṃ badzra puṣpe pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ nas/ shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ bdud rtsi/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las thod pa/ de'i nang du bi mu ra su ma las bdud rtsi lnga/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ rlung gis me sbar/ mes thod pa bsros/ rdo rje'i rnam pa lta bu'i rlangs pa 'thon/ yang bsil bar bya ba'i phyir te/ mtho gang tsam du yaṃ gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin oṃ gyis byin gyis brlabs pa de las kha ba lta bu'i bdud rtsi babs pas bsil bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas lha rnams kyis myangs pas tshim par bsam mo/ /de nas/ dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin te// lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin dang*// tshig dang bral ba sgra brnyan 'dra// rdo rje sems dpa' de la 'dud// khrag 'thung yon tan zab mnga' ba// dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin mchog /sems can kun la phan dgyes dang*// sna tshogs sde la rtag tu 'dud// dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po che// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dra ba sdom// sna tshogs sde la phyag 'tshal lo// ces phyag bya/ rgyas par na/ phyogs re re nas mchod bstod bya/ de nas thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu/ dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo ni// sdig pa ma lus zad byed pa// sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor ni// mgon po chen pos bshad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pa la gsan nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis snying rje chen po bskyed de/ rten brten pa dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor snying gar bsdus nas bdag nyid he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rgyan thams cad dang ldan par gyur pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ mig ma dang ṭa las nyi zla/ mig 'bras hūm̐ las rdo rje mthing nag rkang mthil gnyis su a las sna tshogs rdo rje 'bar ba/ mig 'bras kyi rdo rje las khro bo 'phros pas bgegs kyi tshogs 'joms par byed pa rkang 'gros kyis rdo rje'i ra ba sogs sprul par

bsgoms la/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol bas dbang ldan du song ste/ nyon cig bgegs tshogs ma lus kun// lha dang lha min gsang ba pa// gnod par gyur pa'i bgegs tshogs rnams// sangs rgyas thod pa'i rnal 'byor gtso// bde chen ye shes las byung ba// de ni he ru ka dpal dngos// bka' yi 'khor lo rab sbyor byed// gal te bka' las 'das gyur na// rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba yis// mgo ni tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing*// 'jig par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// de bas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis// zhes bka' bsgos te g.yas skor lan gsum byas/ rkang pa'i 'og nas bskal pa'i me lta bu'i 'od zer 'phros pas gdug pa can thams cad bsregs shing phan tshun du byer bar bsams la gom brgyad la sogs pa'i gar bya'o// yungs dkar gyis brabs/ gu gul bdugs/ na maḥ sa manta buddhe bhyo/ na mo badzrakro dhā ya/ mahā daṃṣṭāo ṭa bhe ra bā ya/ oṃ da ka ta/ badzra santo haṃ/ darpa ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ/ gar mi shes pa'am spros pa la mi dga' na slar yang dbus su langs te/ kha yi padma'i 'dzum dang bcas// cung zad dmar ba'i mche ba 'chang*// kunda ltar dkar so yi phreng*// dpal ldan khrag 'thung rnal 'byor che// sems can grol ba rmad du byung*// de la sogs pa'i gar gyis ni// bgegs kun ma lus bskrad par bya// zhes brjod par gsungs/ de nas seng ldeng gi phur bu srid du sor bcu gnyis sbom su sor bzhi pa tsan dan dmar pos kha bsgyur ba mgor me tog yungs kar kha dog sna lnga pa'i skud pa dkris pa bcu bkod la/ bsangs/ sumbha ni sogs/ bdag nyid he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas byung ba'i gnod mdzes la bka' bsgos pas de las sprul pa'i gnod mdzes gnyis pa 'ongs te des bgegs dang log 'dren rnams lcags kyus bkug zhags pas bcings/ lcags sgrog gis bsdams/ dril bus mnyes/ phyogs bcur gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i khar khro bo bcu stod khro bo smad rtse mo gcig pa'i rdo rje phur bu'i rnam par snang ba/

oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya/ lan bdun bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/ thugs ka nas spros pa'i 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi khro bo bcu spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par bstim/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor gnas pa la/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣṭān bighnāṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra kī la badzra dha ra ādzñā pa ya ti/ sarba duṣṭān kā ya wā ka tsitta badzra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra mutga ra badzra kī la ya ā ko ṭa ya/ zhes gnod mdzes kyi rdo rje lcags kyu de rdo rje tho ba me rab tu 'bar bar gyur pas phur bu rnams bsdigs pas bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas gsang ba'i bar du phugs ste sa gzhi la sbrags nas g.yo 'gul med cing bde ba chen po'i ror gyur/ de rnams las ye shes kyi me kha dog lnga rab tu 'bar bas gdug pa thams cad bsregs par gyur/ dngos su las kyi rdo rjes phyogs bcur gdab/ de nas/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa nyid/ raṃ las nyi ma la hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de las rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi ra ba dra ba dang bcas pa'i gur du gyur par bsam mo// bgegs bsal ba'i cho ga'o// bdag nyid sangs rgyas thod pa'i nga rgyal gyis lag pa sa la reg pas/ hūm̐ khaṃ zhes pas/ sa gzhi de nyid nam mkhar song*/ hūm̐ laṃ zhes pas/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ oṃ me dī ni badzri bha wa badzra bandha hūm̐/ sa gzhi rnam par dag pa de bzhin nyid du mos/ der zhi drag gi sbyin sreg bya/ de nas sa phyogs gsar pa yin na lto 'phye brtags la sa brko/ ro lnga bsal/ sa la bdud rtsi lnga dang dri chu hūm̐ bzlas pa 'thor ba'i sas dgang*/ 'thas bar bcag khar dri dang ba byung gi rnam lnga byug slar sangs rgyas thod pa'i nga rgyal gyis bdud rtsi 'thor/ oṃ hūm̐ hri hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐ a hūm̐ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha ye/

zhes brjod pas de stong par gyur/ oṃ he ru ka badzra sa ma ya hri sarba duṣṭāṃ sa ma ya mu ṭa/ pra pañdza ka hūm̐/ ru lu ru lu bhyo hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes sa la bdud rtsi lnga byug cing dris thig le bya/ der lha gnas ma 'chol bar me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ gtso bo'i snying po kho na brjod pas dgod de/ mchod gtor rgyas par bshams la/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor bsangs nas/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi gzhir raṃ las nyi ma/ de'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje sogs nas rtsa rnams bzhag bdag nyid kyi ro/ dbus su yi ge hūm̐ las dpal he ru ka sangs rgyas thod pa sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa sogs nas 'khor dang bcas pa rgyu dus ltar/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa'i bar/ oṃ buddhā ka pā la ni pra war satka ra badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ sogs mchod yon sngon du 'gro bas rnam lnga rol mo dang bcas pa/ 'dod pa lnga la sogs pas mchod pa dang*/ bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje dang ni padma 'dus shing bdud rtsis bde rgyas shing*// rim gyis yongs gyur sku can sems can don du gar byed pa// rdo rje lha mo'i rtsed mo rol pas rtser mdzod 'gro rmongs la// 'gro la mi dman kun dga' ster ba khyod la bdag 'dud do// zhes bstod/ spros pa la dga' na/ mchod bstod rnams rgyas pa dngos gzhi mdun dkyil skabs ltar kha bskang bas chog go /de nas spos dang bcas pas rdor dril 'dzin bzhin btud de/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba// khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid can// ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal// sna tshogs bde mar yang dag ldan// phyogs mtshams rnams kyi mkha' 'gro ma// rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can// byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// slob ma bdag cag la ni phan pa dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// rdo rje can bdag 'di zhes pas// nang par dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te// kun gyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol//

zhes pa'i bar gyis lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ slar mchod pa kha gso zhing 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ dri chu sogs kyis mchod par bya ba ste/ 'dzag pa de las rnal 'byor ma// brgyad po bu mo rnams kyi mchog /mchod pa sna tshogs 'dzin pa yis// mgon po he ru ka mchod do// rdo rje mgon po'i shar gnas pa// rdo rje mche ba ma yis ni// thod pa khrag gis bkang bzung ste// gzi brjid chen po gsol bar mdzad// rdo rje pho nya bdag nyid che// dbang ldan tu ni cang te'u brdung*// rdo rje gdong ma dri snod dang*// me yi phyogs su rnam par gnas// rdo rje can ma grags chen mo// mchod yon snod can bden bral na// rdo rje gtsigs ma lho yi ni// phyogs na rnga bo che 'dzin gsungs// rlung du rdo rje lte ba ma// ri bong can gyi snod 'dzin no// nub tu rdo rje 'jigs ma ni// ce spyang phyag na 'dzin par gsungs// byang du 'dod chags rdo rje ma// lha mo'i chags pas gtso bo mchod// de ltar he ru ka bsam nas// rnal 'byor ma ni brgyad kyis mchod// sna tshogs zas dang sna tshogs skom// sna tshogs rol mo mchog gsungs dang*// dri zhim lnga dang me tog spos// 'di dag gis ni gtso bo mchod// mchod yon zhabs bsil de bzhin khrus// glu yi mchog ni rnam mang pos// mgon po khrag 'thung bdag nyid che// 'di dag gis ni mchod par bya//

zhes mchod/ lha lhag gnas so// ༈ de nas bum pa mtshan ldan mtshan ma ras dkar gyis mgul dkris/ shing bzang po'i lo mas kha brgyan/ nyer lnga dang chu gtsang mas bkang*/ spos kyis bdugs/ bgegs bskrad/ lha grangs sam med na las thams cad pa dang gnyis/ bum pa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtso bo'i bum pa'i nang du padma'i steng du nyi ma/ de steng chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid kyi ro/ de'i steng du a ā/ i ī sogs/ tshar gnyis yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de steng du ka kha ga gha nga*/ sogs/ ḍa ḍha/ tshar gnyis yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ yig de nyid kyi snang ba las grub pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon na thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ hūm̐ zhes sgrog cing skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa 'jigs shing khro ba'i bdag nyid stag gi pags pa'i na bza' mnabs pa/ mgo rlon bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya drug dang dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lngas brgyan cing*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog nag po can/ gtso bo'i shes rab chen mo sna tshogs bde ma dkar mo zhal shin tu 'gyur ma/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pas 'jigs pa/ g.yas na ḍā ma ru 'chang zhing gri gug brdeg pa'i tshul/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba'i rgyun 'dzag pa yab la stob cing kha ṭwāṃ ga gru mo la gzer ba/ gcer bu rgyan dang bral ba/ skra grol ba/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis yab dang 'khril ba/ gnyis ka'ang 'od kyi 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i klong na bzhugs pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi shar du phreng bzang ma dkar mo/ byang du 'od can ma ser mo/ nub tu 'jigs ma dmar mo/ lho ru thub dka' nag mo/ mtshams bzhir bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa bzhi/

de'i phyi rol gyi shar du dge ba'i ska rags ma/ byang du gzugs can ma/ nub tu rnam rgyal ma/ lho ru byed ma/ dbang ldan du thod pa can/ mer mtsho can ma/ bden bral du rgyud byed ma/ rlung du gsod byed ma/ de'i phyi rol tu shar du sgrol byed ma/ byang du 'jigs ma/ nub tu lā ma/ lhor mi pham ma/ dbang ldan du dge ma/ mer 'jur byed ma/ bden bral du dus mtshan ma/ rlung du grags can ma/ de'i phyi rol shar du mdzes sdug ma/ byang du nor 'dzin ma/ nub tu skal bzang ma/ lhor grags mthong ma/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa/ stag gi pags pas sked pa dkris shing*/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer rnon po gtibs pa/ skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba/ kha nas khrag 'thor ba/ khu ba dang ldan pa'o// lha grangs kyi bum pa yod na/ rnam rgyal du gtso bo yab yum/ bum pa gzhan rnams su 'khor rnams/ gnyis las med tshe rnam rgyal chen por lha thams cad yud tsam gyis gsal btab/ las thams cad pa'i bum par hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang kha bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon brkyang gis nyi ma la khro bo'i chas kyis brgyan te bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i snying khar oṃ/ dpral bar hām̐/ spyi gtsug tu hai/ཾ dpung pa gnyis su hauṃ/ mig gnyis su heṃ/ gsang bar hoṃ/ lus thams cad du haṃ/ snying gar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje/ snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu/ oṃ buddhā ka pā la ni a/ khaṃ graṃ bhrūṃ bhruṃ aḥ.aḥ.aḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces 'gyings pa dang bcas pas bzlas pas ye shes sems dpa' bkug dam tshig sems dpa' la bcug pas chu dang 'o ma ltar 'dres/ de ltar dpa' bo rdzogs pa/ de nas rtsa'i 'khor lo las byang chub kyi sems 'dzag pa de las rnal 'byor ma rnams sna tshogs pa'i snying rje chen mo dang ldan pa/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab pa/ gos sna tshogs gyon pa/ lang tshos brgyan pa'i rnal 'byor ma brgyad nam mkhar gnas pa bum pa byang chub sems kyis yongs su gang ba a mra'i shing los kha brgyan pa re thogs pa/ rab tu dwangs shing bzhad pa'i zhal gyis rgyal gyur he ru ka /zhes smra ba de mthong nas dbang bskur zhu ba'i phyir gsol ba gdab pa/ brtse ldan grags pa chen po yis// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbang bskur// 'khor ba'i 'dam du 'bying ba bdag /dbang bskur ba yis de sgrol zhig/ bum dbang*/ ji ltar bu tsha med pa'i khyim// shi ma thag tu stong par 'gyur// de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni// ye shes kun gyis stong par 'gyur// gsang dbang*/ ji ltar pi wang sbyor kun tshogs// rgyud dang bral na brdung mi rung*// de ltar dbang dang bral na ni// sngags dang bsam gtan 'grub mi 'gyur// dbang gsum pa/ rmongs pa gang zhig dbang med par// bdag ni dbang bskur zhes smra ba// ji ltar sangs rgyas bzhugs kyi bar// slob mar bcas te dmyal bar 'gro// de ltar mkhyen mdzod rnal 'byor ma// slar yang bdag la dbang bskur stsol// gal te dbang bskur skye med na// he ru ka ru bdag 'gyur ci// de nas rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis rgyal gyur rgyal gyur zhes pas bcom ldan 'das la sogs pa la khrus gsol zhing phyi dang gsang bar bcas pa'i dbang bskur ba tsam gyis nam mkha'i ngos nas rnga'i sgra grag cing tsandan dang me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro// dbang bskur zin nas rnal 'byor ma rnams rtsa'i 'khor lo la thim/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab par gyur/ snying kha nas phyung ba'i rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis mchod par bsam la/ oṃ buddhā ka pā la ni pra war satka ra badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ lha yi me tog shin tu 'bar// lha yis dri yis nye bar byugs// me tog bzang po 'di bzhes la// gnas 'di nyid du bzhugs su gsol// oṃ āḥbadzra puṣpe pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/

tsandan gur gum sbyar ba yi// dri mchog bdug spos dam pa 'di// dbang po'i sgo rnams tshim pa'i mchog /byin gyis rlobs la bzhes su gsol// dhū pe= mar me 'od bzang 'bar ba 'di// ngan 'gro'i mun pa 'joms byed cing*// lha yi mig 'byed dam pa 'di// bdag la dgongs te bzhes su gsol// dī paṃ= sna tshogs lha yi dri dang ldan// sna tshogs ga pur gyis ni brgyan// sna tshogs hūm̐ las yang dag byung*// dri mchog 'di dag bzhes su gsol// gandhe= kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa// bza' ba'i bye brag sna tshogs pa// zhal zas thams cad phun sum tshogs// 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// nai wi dye= pa ṭa ha dang cang te'u dang*// rnga dang dung sogs sgra dbyangs dang*// yid 'phrog sil snyan sna tshogs pa// he ru ka yi tshogs la 'bul/ shapta pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ ces rnam lnga rol mo dang bcas pa dang*/ gzugs gsum rgyal ba rnam snang mdzad// bde chen gcig las du ma'i gar// brtan g.yo'i rnam pa thams cad pas// dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyi bar 'tshal// oṃ āḥbadzra rū pa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ sgra gsum he ru ka dpal mgon// bde chen gcig las du ma'i gar// rol mo'i dbyangs snyan thams cad pas// dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyi bar 'tshal// shapta= dri gsum rdo rje nyin mor byed// bde chen gcig las du ma'i gar// dri mchog byug spos thams cad pas// dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyi bar 'tshal// gandhe= ro gsum padma gar gyi dbang*// bde chen gcig las du ma'i gar// ro mchog bza' btung thams cad pas// dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyi bar 'tshal// rā sye= reg gsum don yod grub pa dngos// bde chen gcig las du ma'i gar// bsam yas bde 'byung thams cad pas// dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyi bar 'tshal// sparshe= zhes 'dod yon lngas mchod/ lcags kyu lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga// dngos grub kun gyi bdag nyid mchog

/dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyi bar 'tshal// rgyal ba'i ye shes lnga thob shog /oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pu dza kha hi/ ces bdud rtsi 'bul/ rdo rje dang ni padma 'dus shing bdud rtsis bde rgyas shing*// rim gyis yongs gyur sku can sems can don du gar byed pa// rdo rje lha mo'i rtsed mo rol pas rtser mdzod 'gro rmongs la// 'gro la mi dman kun dga' ster ba khyod la bdag 'dud do// zhes bstod// las thams cad par/ hūm̐/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/ de nas rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa la snying po/ oṃ buddhā ka pā la ni a hrīḥhe hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces dang*/ bum pa gzhan rnams la nye snying*/ oṃ ka pā la badzri ni hūm̐ he du rakṣe hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces dang*/ las thams cad pa la/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bzlas/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba// sogs nas/ bum pa bzang po bsgrub par 'tshal// rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te// kun gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes pa 'don pa bsgyur bas so// bum pa'i lha rnams 'od du zhu bdud rtsir bsam/ bum pa lhag gnas so// ༈ slob mas maṇḍal phul/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul ston pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis slob ma rnams bsdus/ zhal nas zhugs te rjes chags kyis bzhu ba rdo rje nas lha mo'i padmar lhung ba he ru ka sangs rgyas thod par gyur nas phyir 'thon so so'i gdan la 'khod pa'i mos pa gyis/

de nas/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bshad par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir gang bzhugs pa// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med de// skyob pa dpal ldan he ru kas// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /gong nas gong ma'i sdom pa ni// bu khyod kyis ni bzung bya ste// grol ba'i rgyu ni de las gzhan// thabs ni ci yang yod ma yin// zhes sogs spro ba bskyed pa dang*/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*// bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba// sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su// ma lus so sor bshags par bgyi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyis// bsgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams kyi// tshogs dag la ni yi rang ngo*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas thod pa mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la rtag tu skyabs su 'chi// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa'i bdag nyid che// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan khrag 'thung dpa' bo dang*// rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med sogs// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag cag dus 'di nas bzung ste// ji srid gnyis med la gnas par// de yis tshangs spyod gnyis med pa// byang chub mchog sems bskyed par bgyi// bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams kyis// sangs rgyas myur du 'grub byas te// sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// bla med gnas su bsgral bar bgyi//

lan gsum/ de nas slob ma'i snying mgrin dpral bar hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ mas rim gyis rdo rjes reg cing dris thig le bya/ oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ sogs slar yas rim gyis bya'o/ /mchod yon dang rnam lnga rol mos mchod/ so shing tshad ldan tshom bu lnga bkod pa'i maṇḍal du rtsa ba so la drud de/ badzra hā sa ha/ zhes pas dor/ rtse mo gar bstan pas dngos grub 'grub pa'i brda sprad/ oṃ hrīḥbi shuddha dhārma sarba pā paṃ ni tsā sya bi sho dha ya sarba bi kalpān a pa na ya hūm̐/ ces pas khyor chu byin/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams// u dumba ra'i me tog ltar// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'di ni// de bas kyang ni rnyed dka' ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// bla na med pa byed par nus// gnyis med zab mo'i tshul 'di yis// sems can sangs rgyas thob byed pa// dang po bskal pa grangs med nas// bsags pa'i sdig pa gang dang gang*// de kun zad par 'gyur ba ni// zab mo'i dkyil 'khor mthong bas so// de nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i ku sha sngas dang stan du sbyin no// snying po bzlas pa'i srad bu dmar po mdud pa gsum pa dpung pa g.yon par gdags so/ ku sha'i gdan la khyod nyol la// nang par bzhin bzang rnams longs shig /sang gi nang par khyed rnams kyis// dpal ldan sangs rgyas thod pa yi// grong khyer chen po mthong bar 'gyur// zhes brjod/ mchod pa kha gso zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis rlabs/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mos dkyil 'khor la mchod par gyur/ oṃ buddhā ka pā la ni pra war satka ra badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ sngags thog mtha' 'dra bas/ oṃ āḥbadzra puṣpe pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ dhu pe= ā lo ke= gandhe= nai wi dya=

shapta pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ bdud rtsi/ yaṃ las rlung sogs nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas lha rnams kyis myang bas tshims par bsam mo// de nas gtor ma swa bhā wa 'i sngags brjod/ stong pa nyid raṃ las nyi ma sogs nas gshegs su gsol ba'i bar sgrub thabs ltar 'byung po la gtor ma byin/ dkyil 'khor nam mkhar yid kyis 'degs so// nang par rmi lam dri/ ngan na sbyin sreg gis bzlog pa'i cho ga bya'o// slob ma lhag gnas so// ༈ de nas bdag bskyed bya/ thig dkyil 'khor gnyis 'dab yod pa kha dog lngar dbye ba thod pa'i snod du bzhag bsang sbyangs/ thig skud mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las dkar po bhrūm̐ las rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ ser po dzriṃ las rin 'byung ser po mnyam bzhag mchog sbyin/ dmar po oṃ las snang mtha' dmar po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ ljang khu khaṃ las don grub ljang khu mnyam bzhag dang skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya can du gsal ba la

smin ma gyen du blta ba 'bar ba'i lta stangs kyis/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis dpal sangs rgyas thod pa la sogs pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de dang gnyis su med par bsres/ rang byung gi me tog sogs/ oṃ badzra puṣpe pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ nas/ shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ de dag zhu ba ye shes kyi skud par gyur/ sna gcig slob dpon gyis gzung*/ dzaḥ brjod pas slob mar gtad/ shī shā dbugs 'byin pa 'gro bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmāḥpa ra sa pa ra a nu pra biṣṭha sarba dharmāḥ.a dyanta a nu pra biṣṭa sarba dharmāḥ.oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bsgril/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya sū tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing nam mkhar thig rtsa gdab dus/ phyogs bcu 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i// sangs rgyas la sogs 'gro ba'i don// khyed kyi dus ni yin zhes bskul// ces dmigs so// las thig man ngag bzhin gdab/ de nas tshon thig bzhin byin gyis brlab/ pho brang nang ma rim pa gsum pa zlum po rdo rje'i ra bas bskor ba'i nang ma 'dab brgyad/ phyogs mdog mtshams mdzes tshon la bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa/ mu khyud rdo rje'i 'phreng ba sngon po/ bar ma dmar/ phyi ma dkar po rtsibs brgyad/ rtsibs mchan ljang khu dang nag po/ mu khyud pad dmar dang rdo rje dkar po/ lha khyams phyogs mdog dbus kyi mtshan ma ro'i khar rdo rje nag po dang gri gug dmar po/ gzhan gri gug lha'i kha dog bzhin bri/ rtsig pa phyi nas dkar ser dmar ljang ba/ 'dod snam dmar/ pha gu ser/ mun pa nag shar bu sngo/ mda' yab dkar po/ khyams ljang*/ rta babs snam bu bcu gcig rdo ra sngon po/ me ri sna tshogs pa'o// ༈ de nas dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dngos la/ dang po dkyil 'khor gyi gnas brgyan pa ni/ rgyud las/ sna tshogs gos dang rgyal mtshan dang*// bla bre la sogs bri ba dang*// spos dang me tog la sogs pa'i// mchod pa'i rgyan gyis sna tshogs brgyan// zhes pa gsungs pa bzhin/

rgyan gyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa spyi dang*/ khyad par yang rgyud las/ ba dan rnam pa brgyad kyis brgyan// zhes gsungs pa'i phyogs kyi mdog can gyi ba dan brgyad nges par gzugs /lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs pas bskor/ rnam rgyal bum pa lho sgo dang*/ las bum byang sgor 'god par gsungs pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi zhal 'jig rten pa'i lho phyogs su mdzad pa ste/ dkyus la rnam bum shar sgor 'god/ bdag 'jug sogs la mkho ba'i yo byad rnams kyang mthong rgyud ltar 'god do// de nas rdo rje slob dpon bdag nyid bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ rang gi snying khar a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ 'od zer lnga ldan sogs tshogs bsags nas bzung bdag bskyed bzlas pa rdzogs pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin btang nas/ mdun gyi rdul tshon dang ras bris gang yin gyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs nas/ mdun rten gyi dkyil 'khor mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ de'i ngang las raṃ las nyi ma de'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje nag po dpag tu med pa spros/ rdo rje'i ra ba dang drwa ba rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ de'i dbus su e gru gsum gyi cha byad can chos kyi 'byung gnas/ de'i dbus su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gnyis dang yaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar ba bdun dang raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i dbus su baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa dang baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i dbus su laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rdo rje dang laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi snam bu bcu gcig pas brgyan pa mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa rgyan gyis legs par spras pa'i dbus su padma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba mthing*/

phyogs dkar ser dmar ljang*/ mtshams ci mdzes pa/ de'i phyir 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dmar po rtsibs mchan ljang kha/ de'i phyir rtsibs brgyad dkar po rtsibs mchan nag po/ rim pa gsum po mu khyud rdo rje sngon po dang padma dmar po dang rdo rje dkar pos byas pa/ lte ba'i dbus su chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid kyi ro/ dbus su yi ge hūm̐ las dpal he ru ka sangs rgyas thod pa sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon na thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ hūm̐ zhes sgrog cing skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa 'jigs shing khro ba'i bdag nyid stag gi pags pa'i na bza' mnabs pa/ mgo rlon bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya drug dang dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lngas brgyan cing*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog nag po can/ gtso bo'i shes rab chen mo sna tshogs bde ma dkar mo zhal shin tu 'gyur ma/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pas 'jigs pa/ g.yas na ḍā ma ru 'chang zhing gri gug brdeg pa'i tshul/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba'i rgyun 'dzag pa yab la stob cing kha ṭwāṃ ga gru mo la gzer ba/ gcer bu rgyan dang bral ba/ skra grol ba/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis yab dang 'khril ba/ gnyis ka'ang 'od kyi 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i klong na bzhugs pa/ lha gnas rnams su hūm̐ nyi shu rtsa bzhi las skad cig gis/ shar gyi 'dab mar 'phreng bzang ma dkar mo/ byang du 'od can ma ser mo/ nub tu 'jigs ma dmar mo/ lhor thub dka' ma nag mo/ mtshams bzhir bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa bzhi/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i rtsibs la dge ba'i ska rags ma dang*/ gzugs can ma dang*/ rnam rgyal ma dang*/ byed ma rnams phyogs la/ thod pa can dang*/ mtsho chen ma dang*/ rgyud byed ma dang*/ gsod byed ma rnams dmar mo mtshams la/ sku'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs la/

sgrol byed ma dang*/ 'jigs ma dang*/ lā ma dang*/ mi phaṃ ma rnams phyogs dang*/ dge ma dang*/ 'jur byed ma dang*/ dus mtshan ma dang*/ drag chen ma mtshams/ de rnams dkar mo phyogs shar nas g.yon/ mtshams dbang ldan nas g.yas skor du/ de thams cad nyi ma la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa/ shar sgor mdzes ma dkar mo/ byang sgor nor 'dzin ma ser mo/ nub sgor skal bzang ma dmar mo/ lho sgor grags mthong ma nag mo/ nyi ma dang ro'i steng du g.yon brkyangs pa'i zhabs kyis gnas pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa stag gi pags pas sked pa dkris shing rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer rnon po gtibs pa/ skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba/ kha nas khrag 'thor ba khu ba dang ldan pa/ gtso bo'i snying kha'i oṃ/ dpral bar hām̐/ spyi gtsug tu hai/ཾ dpung pa gnyis su hauṃ/ mig gnyis su heṃ/ gsang bar hoṃ/ lus thams cad du haṃ/ snying gar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje/ (snying ga nas sprul pa'i 'od zer gyis sta gon gyi lha nam mkhar bzhugs pa spyan drangs de la bstim/sta gon gyi lha bstim pa 'di sgrub mchod kyi skabs nyin dang po las rgyun du mi dgos/) snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu/ oṃ buddhā ka pā la ni a khaṃ graṃ bhrūṃ bhruṃ aḥ.aḥ.aḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces 'gyings pa dang bcas pas bzlas pas ye shes sems dpa' bkug dam tshig sems dpa' la bcug pas chu dang 'o ma ltar 'dres/ de ltar dpa' bo rdzogs pa/ de nas rtsa'i 'khor lo las byang chub kyi sems 'dzag pa de las rnal 'byor ma rnams sna tshogs pa'i snying rje chen mo dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab pa/ gos sna tshogs gyon pa/ lang tshos brgyan pa'i rnal 'byor ma brgyad nam mkhar gnas pa bum pa byang chub sems kyis yongs su gang ba a mra'i shing los kha brgyan pa re thogs pa/

rab tu dwangs shing bzhad pa'i zhal gyis rgyal gyur he ru ka /zhes smra ba de mthong nas dbang bskur zhu ba'i phyir gsol ba gdab pa/ brtse ldan grags pa chen po yis// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbang bskur// 'khor ba'i 'dam du 'bying ba bdag /dbang bskur ba yis de sgrol zhig/ bum dbang*/ ji ltar bu tsha med pa'i khyim// shi ma thag tu stong par 'gyur// de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni// ye shes kun gyis stong par 'gyur// gsang dbang*/ ji ltar pi wang sbyor kun tshogs// rgyud dang bral na brdung mi rung*// de ltar dbang dang bral na ni// sngags dang bsam gtan 'grub mi 'gyur// dbang gsum pa/ rmongs pa gang zhig dbang med par// bdag ni dbang bskur zhes smra ba// ji ltar sangs rgyas bzhugs kyi bar// slob mar bcas te dmyal bar 'gro// de ltar mkhyen mdzod rnal 'byor ma// slar yang bdag la dbang bskur stsol// gal te dbang bskur skye med na// he ru ka ru bdag 'gyur ci// de nas rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis rgyal gyur rgyal gyur zhes pas bcom ldan 'das la sogs pa la khrus gsol zhing phyi dang gsang bar bcas pa'i dbang bskur ba tsam gyis nam mkha'i ngos nas rnga'i sgra grag cing tsandan dang me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro// dbang bskur zin nas rnal 'byor ma rnams rtsa'i 'khor lo la thim/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab par gyur/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba'i rim pa ni/ snying ga nas sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa thogs pa rnams kyis mchod par mos/ lha yi chu bo yan lag brgyad ldan sogs// gtsang zhing yid 'ong mchod yon rmad byung bas// rab 'byams zhing rnams gang bar sprul byas te// sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor lha rnams mchod// oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra satka ra arthaṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/

pad kor rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas mchod yon sbreng ba'i tshul dang mthar bsdu ba bya'o/ /gzhan snga ma ltar la rkang pa gnyis par/ lha yi chu bo= gtsang zhing yid 'ong zhabs bsil rmad byung bas// rab 'byams= sangs rgyas= oṃ āḥhrīḥ= arghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā dyaṃ bcug nas/ mdzub mos me tog blangs nas ni// khu tshur 'og tu kha bstan te// mthe chung srin lag gung mo dang*// mdzub mo rim gyis dgrol zhing dbul// zhes bshad pa'i phyag rgya dang sbyar ro// des 'gres te/ rkang pa gnyis par/ lha yi chu bo= gtsang zhing yid 'ong 'thor 'thung rmad byung ba// rab 'byams= sangs rgyas= zhes dang*/ prokṣa ṇaṃ sbyar te chu gsum 'bul/ de nas/ rab rgyas 'dab ma kha dog sna tshogs can// dri zhim rdzi ngad phyogs rnams kun khyab pa// me tog char 'bebs lha mo gser gyi mdog /nam mkha' gang bas dkyil 'khor lha rnams mchod// oṃ buddhā ka pā la ni ma ṭa a swā hā/ 'jig rten khyab par bdug pa'i sprin 'byung ba'i// tsandan a ga ru dang du ruṣka// lha rdzas spos thogs lha mo kha dog sngo// nam mkha' gang bas= rkang pa bzhi pa thams la sbyar zhing*/ oṃ buddha ka pā li ni ta ṭa spho ṭa ya sarba shu bha pra dā yi ne hūm̐ phaṭ/ phyogs kun snang byed nyi ma gnyis pa bzhin// 'od zer dpag med rin chen sgron me 'dzin// rab mdzes lha mo sku mdog shin tu dmar// nam mkha' gang bas= oṃ buddha ka pā li ni gṛ hṇa gṛ hṇa gṛ hṇā pa ya gṛ hṇā pa ya ba ra ba ra ta ṭa ta ṭa sta ṭa ya sta ṭa ya/ ma ṭa ma ṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ dbang po kun tu tshim byed dri bsung can// gur gum utpal la sogs sbyar las byung*// dri chab bzang po'i snod 'dzin lha mo ljang*// nam mkha' gang bas= oṃ ma hā ka pā la badzri ba ra ba ra ta ṭa ta ṭa sta ḍa ya sta ḍa ya ma ṭa ma ṭa hūm̐ he swā hā/ kha dog dri dang ro bcud phun sum tshogs// lha mi'i bsod nams mthu las legs grub pa'i// zhal zas gang ba'i snod thogs lha mo dkar/

nam mkha' gang bas= oṃ buddha ka pā li ni gṛ hṇa gṛ hṇa gṛ hṇā pa ya gṛ hṇā pa ya khā kha hūm̐/ sna tshogs sgra snyan du ma 'byung ba yi// rol mo'i bye brag rnam pa kun ldan pa// bstod dbyangs yan lag lnga dang sbyar ba ni// nam mkha' gang bas= oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūm̐/ ces nyer spyod sogs phul/ dzambu chu bo'i gser sbyangs las grub cing*// rtsibs mchog stong ldan sa las rnam rgyal byed// 'khor lo rin chen nam mkha'i khyon bkang ste// phul bas rdo rje'i rgyal srid thob par shog /oṃ shrī he ru ka buddhā ka pā li ni sa pa ri wā ra tsakra ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ des 'gres te/ dpag tshad bye bar nyin bzhin snang byed cing*// rin thang tshad med 'dod dgu'i char chen 'bebs// nor bu rin chen nam mkha'i khyon bkang ste// phul bas don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par shog /ma ṇi ratna= nyes pa sum cu gnyis spangs yon tan chos// de snyed dang ldan yid 'phrog lta na sdug /btsun mo rin chen nam mkha'i khyon bkang ste// phul bas 'pho med bde ba che brnyes shog /st+rī ratna= mkhas shing yid gzhung blo gros phun sum tshogs// dge bcu'i bka' lung sbyin pa'i mdun na 'don// khyim bdag rin chen nam mkha'i khyon bkang ste// phul bas rgyal bstan mtha' dag 'dzin par shog /pu ru ṣa ratna= thal kar stobs ldan kha ba'i ri bo 'dra// mche ba drug ldan gser gyi drwa bas g.yogs// glang po rin chen nam mkha'i khyon bkang ste// phul bas theg mchog bzhon pas bgrod par shog /hasti ratna= cang shes sprin gyi shugs 'chang yid du 'ong*// skad cig tsam gyis 'dod pa'i gnas su skyel// rta mchog rin chen nam mkha'i khyon bkang ste// phul bas rdzu 'phrul dpag med shugs thob shog /a shā ratna= sgyu rtsal drug cu bzhi rdzogs phas rgol 'joms// dpa' zhing brtul phod mi yi gdong lnga pa// dmag dpon rin chen nam mkha'i khyon bkang ste// phul bas bdud dang nyon mongs g.yul 'joms shog

/khatga ratna= ces rin chen bdun phul/ mtha' yas zhing na gzugs kyi bye brag ni// mchog dman bar ma'i khyad par ci snang ba// bde ba chen po bskyed par byed pa yi// gzugs kyi rdo rjer sprul nas mchod par bgyi// rū pa= 'jig rten kun tu sgra yi dbye ba ni// zin dang ma zin la sogs la sogs ji snyed pa// grag stong sngags kyi rol par 'char ba dag /sgra yi rdo rjer sprul nas mchod par bgyi// shapta= rab 'byams zhing na dri yi rnam pa gang*// yongs su gyur dang de bzhin sbyar ba sogs// rnam kun rdo rje dri brnyan dang ldan pa'i// 'dod yon lha mos rtag tu mchod par bgyi// gandhe= dpag tu med pa'i gnas dang zhing khams su// ro yi khyad par rnam pa drug la sogs// zag med ting 'dzin zas mchog ster byed pa// ro yi rdo rjer sprul nas mchod par bgyi// rā sye= phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rnams na reg bya'i tshogs// rnam pa du mar nyer spyad gzhi rnams kyang*// phul byung bde ba 'pho med skyed nus pa// reg bya'i rdo rjer sprul nas mchod par bgyi// sparshe=

ces 'dod yon lnga phul/ gos zung lha grangs dang mnyam pa/ srab 'jam yangs pa lha yi gos// sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ ma hā ka pā li ni badzra dharma dharma me gha ba re pra ba re ba ra ba ra ka ra ka ra ta ḍa ta ḍa ha he swā hā/ zhes pas 'bul/ lha mo brgyad ni/ snying ga'i sa bon las lha mo brgyad spros te dkyil 'khor pa rnams mchod par gyur/ sgeg cing lang tsho dang ldan lha mo ni// rdo rje mche ba 'chi bdag kun 'joms ma// pad snod sihla raktas gang ba 'dzin// nam mkha' gang bas dkyil 'khor lha rnams mchod// oṃ shrī he ru ka buddha ka pā li ni sa pa ri wā ra badzra daṃṣṭī ṇi pra tītstsha āḥhūm̐/ pad kor g.yon khu tshur gyi steng du g.yas pa'i thal mo bkan pa dmar cha'i snod 'dzin pa'i tshul dang bsdu ba bya'o// rkang pa thog mtha' gnyis 'dra ba la/ sgeg cing lang tsho= rdo rje pho nya cang te'u sgra sgrogs pas// gzhom du med pa'i sgra yis chos ston ma// nam mkha' gang bas= khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo dang mthe'u chung cung zad dgug pa ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba'i tshul gyis/ badzra du ti= sgeg cing lang tsho= rdo rje gdong ma bcud ldan rnam snang gi /yongs su gang ba'i mchog gi thod pa 'dzin// nam mkha' gang bas= g.yon thal mo bkan pa'i mthil du g.yas pa'i sor mo bzhi bsdus te bzhag pa sman 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis/ badzra mu khi= sgeg cing lang tsho= rdo rje can ma lha rdzas argha sogs// rmad byung bdud rtsis gang ba'i snod thogs pa// nam mkha' gang bas= mchod yon gyi phyag rgyas/ badzra wa ti= sgeg cing lang tsho= rdo rje gtsigs ma thal mo bskyed pa yis// phyogs kun khyab pa'i sgra ldan rnga chen brdungs// nam mkha' gang bas= lag gnyis thal mo 'phred du res mos kyis rnga brdung ba'i tshul gyis/ badzra ka ra lī= sgeg cing lang tsho= rdo rje lta ba ma ni ga pur dang*// zla zhun rang bzhin dkar cha'i snod 'dzin pa// nam mkha' gang bas=

g.yas khu tshur gyi steng du g.yon pa'i thal mo bkan pa dkar cha 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis/ badzra na bhī= sgeg cing lang tsho= rdo rje 'jigs ma phyag gnyis snod chen po// stobs kyi rgyur gyur ce spyang shas bkang ba// nam mkha' gang bas= khu tshur gnyis kha'i drung du bzung ba sha 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis/ badzra bhī ma= sgeg cing lang tsho= sna tshogs sde dang dbyer med shes rab ni// snyoms 'jug bde bskyed 'dod chags rdo rje ma// nam mkha' gang bas= 'khyud pa'i rgyas/ rā ga badzrī= nang mchod 'bul ba/ nang gi bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga rnams spyan drangs/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems dang 'dres/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padmar babs pa/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin du gnas pa la/ lha thams cad ljags las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis sbu gus drangs nas/ gsol bas tshim zhing mnyes par gyur/ de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las byung*// gdug pa 'dul mdzad khro bo'i sku// mi bzad ha har bzhad pa yi// khrag 'thung sku la phyag 'tshal 'dud// bdud kyi dkyil 'khor pham mdzad cing*// rdo rje'i hūm̐ mdzad yi ge hūm̐// cha lugs du ma rab tu 'jigs// 'jigs byed 'jigs par mdzad la 'dud// seng ge 'phrog byed tshangs pa'i gtsos// gang gi zhabs la phyag 'tshal ba// khams gsum dbang phyug srid gsum 'joms// dpa' bo'i dbang phyug khyod la 'dud// gnyug ma'i dga' ma lhan cig skyes// bdag med don gyi ye shes dngos// sems can kun la phan dgyes pa// sna tshogs bde ma la phyag 'tshal// bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi thugs// shes bya kun la rab g.yo ba// mkha' spyod rnal 'byor skur ston pa// phreng bzang ma sogs la phyag 'tshal// zag med bde ba bcud kyi len// ye shes bdud rtsis gang ba yi// thod pa bzhi po rab sprul pa// mchod pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal 'dud// gang gi gsung dbyangs mi zad pa// 'gro kun bsam pa ji bzhin 'jug

/sa spyod rnal 'byor ma yi tshul// dge ba'i ska rags can sogs 'dud// ji lta ji ltar 'dul ba'i sku// sna tshogs sprul pa thabs kyi don// sa 'og spyod pa'i rnal 'byor ma// sgrol byed ma sogs phyag 'tshal 'dud// zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dgug dang*// mngon spyod phrin las spyod mdzad cing*// 'gro ba'i don la gzhol ba yi// sgo skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba'i khang bzang nyams dga' ba// e yig bha ga chos kyi dbyings// rgyan rnams kun gyis rab tu brgyan// gzhal med khang la gus phyag 'tshal// sna tshogs rdo rje padma nyi// dur khrod chen pos rab skor zhing*// rdo rje'i gur bcings la sogs pa// de dag rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod// ༈ de nas bum bskyed ni/ bum pa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtso bo'i bum pa'i nang du padma'i steng du nyi ma sogs nas/ bum pa'i lha 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsir gyur bar bum pa sta gon gyi skabs ji lta ba'o// tshogs byin brlab/ spyan drangs/ mchod pa rnams bde mchog nas rigs 'gres dang*/ sgrub thabs kyi gtor ma sbyin pa/ swa bhā wa 'i sngags brjod/ stong pa nyid raṃ las nyi ma sogs nas/ gshegs su gsol ba'i bar dang*/ dkyil chog dkyus su mi 'byung yang*/ gzhan du dbang bskur ba la/ bar chad zhi ba'i phyir phyogs skyong la gtor ma sbyin par gsungs pa ltar spro na/ 'dir yang bya ste/ slob dpon phyi rol du song nas/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma dang*/ bra khur la sogs bza' ba dang*// zan dron sha dang nya sha dang*// bdud rtsi lnga sogs ci 'byor ba// thod pa'i nang du legs bzhag ste// sbyang sogs rim gyis byin brlabs nas// zhing skyong rnams la gtor ma sbyin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi mchod pa dang bcas bshams nas/ rang nyid he ru kar gsal ba'i mdun du/ khams gsum gyi sems can ma lus pa dang*/ phyogs skyong dang*/

mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams gsal bar gyur/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ gtor ma'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las thod pa/ de'i nang du bi mu ra su ma las bdud rtsi lnga/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ rlung gis me sbar/ mes thod pa bsros/ rdo rje'i rnam pa lta bu'i rlangs pa 'thon/ yang bsil bar bya ba'i phyir te/ mtho gang tsam du yaṃ gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin oṃ gyis byin gyis brlabs pa de las kha ba lta bu'i bdud rtsi babs pas bsil bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan bdun bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/ lha rnams kyi ljags sbu gu can du gyur pa'i oṃ de'i 'od zer gyis drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ buddhāt+s+ma ka pā la badzra tsi tre su tsi tre/ a laṃ ba ne/ prī ṇā ya/ sarba bhū tān/྄ mā ra ya sarba mā ra na/ kī la ya sarba duṣṭān/ utstsha ṭa ya/ sarba bighnān/྄ bi ṭa wā ya/ bho bha ga wa te/ yakṣa rakṣa sa/ pi shā tsa na/ sho ṣa ya/ tā ḍa ya/ sapta pā tā la ga tā na/ sa ra sa ra/ pra sa ra pra sa ra/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul te/ zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun rdzogs mdzod// ces 'dod don gsol/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// bzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// 'on te skyob pa'i sras su skye// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdig med pa'i// sangs rgyas nyid dang 'phrad gyur cig /lam de nyid la zhugs nas kyang*// ma grol ba rnams grol bar shog /ma brgal ba rnams brgal bar shog /rnal 'byor gtsug lag dam tshig la// da lta nyid du gnas par shog/

se gol lan gsum brdab nas/ mgron rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces gshegs su gsol/ de nas slob dpon bdag 'jug len/ slob ma khrus bya/ mdzes pa'i gos gyon gdong bcing*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo// rnal 'byor gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// don dam smra ba'i seṅge rnal 'byor zhes bya ba// nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa// srid pa'i nyes brgya skyed rtsa nyon mongs choms mdzod la// rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid grub par mdzod// lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ kye khyod su zhig ces dri/ slob mas/ kye bdag ni rgyal ba'i sras lags zhes smra/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gis slob ma bdag nyid rab tu gzhug par bgyi// lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ lho sgor phyogs pas/ oṃ na maste hūm̐/ na mo me hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ lus ngag yid kyis phyag sngon du 'gro/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pū dzo pasthā nā ya ātmā nāṃ niryā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī ātma ma le a dhi tiṣṭha swā māṃ/ lus thams cad kyi gus pas phyag bya/ shar sgor snying ga'i g.yon du thal mo sbyar nas/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī/ pū dzo pasthā nā ya a bhi ṣe kā ya ātmā nāṃ niryā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī ātma ka ma ma dha a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ de nas byang sgor thal mo dpral bar bcas nas/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pū dzo pra warta na ya ātmā nāṃ niryā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī ātma bhi ma pra warta ya māṃ/ nub sgor thal mo mgor bzhag

oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pū dzo karma ni ātmā nāṃ niryā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī ātmā karma ku ru māṃ/ de nas lho sgor 'dug ste/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis gtor la/ slob ma'i lag pa nas bzung ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// 'di ni sangs rgyas rigs yid 'ong*// sdom pa brtan por 'gyur ba'o// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// blo chen khyod kyis bzung bar bya// byang chub sems gang deng rdo rje// shes rab dril bu zhes bsgrags so// slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bar bya// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad// rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni// nyin re bzhin yang lan drug tu// chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*// 'di ni padma'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba 'o// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// zhes pas sdom pa bzung nas/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag oṃ badzra yo ga tsitta utpā da yā mi/ rnal 'byor du sems bskyed/ de nas las thams cad pa'i chu 'thor/ āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis dkyil 'khor du bcug deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ ngas khyod la dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan rnams lta ci zhig smos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/

phan yon/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras gyur na// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes nyes dmigs/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsis chu 'dis thob// oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u ta ka ṭha ṭha ṭha hūm̐/ zhes gnyis ka'i/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi/ ngas gang 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba de bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang ma byed cig /khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung ba 'gyur ta re/ zhes slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam bzhag rnams bya'o// de nas/ dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma// thams cad kyis ni byin gyis rlobs// he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor ma// bdag la ye shes dbab tu gsol// bdud rtsi lnga/ ro ras/ byi brun/ gu gul nag po/ grir shi ba'i klad khrag tshil bu/ rang skra rnams brdungs pa dur khrod kyi mer sreg slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis mkha' 'gro ma bkug ste de la zhugs pa'am/ slob ma'i snying gar sangs rgyas thod pa yum dang bcas pa yungs kar gyi 'bru tsam snyoms par zhugs pas byang sems dmar pos lus gang dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro thams cad de la thim par bsam/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ya/ bidyā ma hā bidyā rā dza dhī ma he swā hā/ babs pa la lce la a dmar po bsam la rdo rje dge mi dge dri/ sku gsung thugs phebs na mgor rdo rje bkod nas brtan par bya phyir/ tiṣṭha badzra zhes brjod/ 'dir ni bsod nams ji lta bu// lha rnams kyi ni rigs ji bzhin// 'di yis dngos grub gang 'grub pa// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ dkyil 'khor du ni me tog dor// gang 'phog de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs// dbu sogs gang la 'phog pas dngos grub ci thob pa brtag

sha'i mig dag pa'i ltas kyi phyir/ dkyil 'khor kha dogs ci mthong dri// de nas/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong bar yang*// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// badzra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hri/ zhes pas mig phye/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu skyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// 'gro ba phun tshogs dngos grub dang*// dngos grub kun khyod mngon du gyur// dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*// gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis// sna tshogs padma'i dkyil steng nas// gnyis su med par legs 'khyud pa'i// dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin can// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba po// khrag 'thung che la bu khyod ltos// sna tshogs bde ma gtsor mdzad pa'i// 'phreng bzang ma sogs lha mo lnga// thod pa bzhi por bcas pa yis// rab zab thugs kyi 'khor lo dang*// dge ba'i 'khor lo can la sogs// gsung gi rnam dag 'khor lo dang*// sgrol byed mkha' 'gro ma la sogs// rnam dag sku yi 'khor lo ste// rab dang 'bring dang mtha' ma can// mdzes sdug la sogs lha mo bzhi// gzugs sogs dag pa'i bdag nyid gyur// lha rnams de nyid mtshan ma yin//

dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'o// de nas bla ma la yon dang maṇḍal phul te/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can// ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas stsal// de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig /dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i// dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon gyur// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas yungs kar lag pa g.yas g.yon du bzung la/ so sor lag gnyis g.yas g.yon du bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzrā ya/ badzra sa twa sya sarba pā paṃ da ha da ha swā hā/ bzlas shing yungs kar me la dor// de bzhin du g.yas su bskor ba'ang bya zhing*/ yang chu dang kham phor dang dur ba dang bcas pa'i ba lci'i chang bu dang zan chang gis kyang bskor zhing de dag mer mi dor/ de nas lag pas nye reg byas la/ snying gar dri/ mgo bor me tog mdun du yon chab mar mes bskor zhing mar dang spos dkar gyis bdugs shing phyir dor ro// de ni bgegs sdigs pa mi shis pa sbyang ba'o// de nas phyogs lhor padma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du seng ge'i khrir dar sna tshogs kyis 'bol ba'i gdan la slob ma bkod/ steng du gdugs dkar po bzung ba'i 'og tu slob ma dpal he ru ka mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i g.yas ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam rlon dang rus pa'i phyag rgya drug stag gi pags pa'i na bza' can/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis gnas pa he ru ka'i mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i gtso bor bskyed/ sngar dor ba'i me tog rigs kyi lhas/ oṃ dharma kundza a bhi ṣiñtsa/ zhes spyi bor bcings par bsam/ de nas slob dpon gyis bum pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i sngags kyis dkyil 'khor la g.yon nas bskor ba lan gsum byas nas de dag gi chu bsdus la/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs spyan drangs/

de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa gyis byas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa/ cod pan bsang sbyangs/ cod pan dar dpyangs dang bcas pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rin chen 'byung gnas ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che yi rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa gsal bar gyur/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bsgoms pa dang mtshungs pa'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ rin 'byung 'od du zhu ba rin po che'i cod pan du gyur/ ces byin gyis brlabs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rin po che cod pan gyis dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa phul/ sogs/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan pa// sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi// rin chen dag gi dbu rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya// oṃ badzra pa taṃ ka badzra ā ra li hoḥ rdo rje rtse dgu pa bsang sbyangs/ rdo rje mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las 'od dpag med dmar po padma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che yi rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan gsal bar gyur/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bsgoms pa dang mtshungs pa'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ snang mtha' 'od du zhu ba rdo rjer gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/

rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i lha mo sogs/ sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas// de ring khyod la dbang bskur bya// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// shin tu grub phyir rdo rje gzung*// oṃ badzra a dhi pa ti st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ lag g.yas su gtad/ snyems pa'i tshul gyis snying gar 'dzin du bcug thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag/ ces brjod/ de nas dril bu bsang sbyangs/ dril bu mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las don yod grub pa ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che yi rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa gsal bar gyur/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bsgom pa dang mtshungs pa'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ don grub 'od du zhu ba dril bur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis dril bu'i dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i lha mo sogs/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed// g.yon du gtad/ dril bu 'khrol du bcug srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// srid pa'i dam pa byed par 'gyur/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti st+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa tiṣṭha bī ra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol du bcug pa phyag rgya chen po dang ldan pa la/ rdo rje dril bu yang dag 'khyud// g.yon snyems pa dang sgros rnon 'chang*// gnyis med gnyis med rnal 'byor te// phyag rgya chen po byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/

oṃ shrī he ru ka nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta kye dpal/ me tog phog pa'i rigs kyi ming btags/ de nas rdo rje lag par gtad la/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs// he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta s-iddhi badzra sa ma ya/ tiṣṭha e ṣa ya st+waṃ/ dha ra yā mi hūm̐/ hi hi hi hoḥ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so// kha ṭwāṃ ga dang ḍā ma ru gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba la/ bsgoms pa dang mtshungs pa'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ /gnyis su med par gyur/ he ru ka 'od du zhu ba kha ṭwāṃ ga dang ḍā ma rur gyur/ he ru ka dpal kha ṭwāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍā ma ru// rdorje kha ṭwāṃ rdo rjer bcas// dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs shing*// tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /kha ṭwāṃ ga dag rnal 'byor snod// dpa' bo chen pos blang bar bgyi// dgang blugs gtad/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sngangs dang dbye dang mnan la sogs// bsad dang bskrad pa thams cad ste// las de rnams ni bsgrub par bgyi// ral gri gtad/ ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*// mchil lahwam de bzhin ril bu ste// rnal 'byor ma yi dngos grub ni// de ni ci dgar bsgrub par bgyi// de nas slob dpon shākya thub par bsgoms pa'i lag pa g.yon pas chos gos kyi mtha' dang*/ g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgyas/ he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor che// 'khor lo ma lus rnam gnas shing*// he ru ka dpal lung ston bzhin// mgrin gcig tu ni thams cad kyis// 'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te// he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs// 'khor lo mchog tu grub pa'i phyir// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton// shrī he ru ka nā mā sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi sa ma ya st+waṃ bhur bhu baḥswaḥ zhes/ he ru ka dang dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu lung ston par

bsam/ de nas dbugs dbyung ba/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du// zhugs pa dang ni mthong bas kyang*// sdig pa kun las nges grol te// de ring khyod rnams legs par gnas// dbang ni bskur ba tsam gyis kyang*// slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur// slob dpon nyid kyi bde ba yis// brtan dang g.yo kun dam tshig yin// nang par sngar langs nyid dang ni// ma lus las ni byas nas kyang*// srung dang bza' ba la sogs pa// sdom pa'i bdag nyid kyis bsrung ngo*// lus dang srog la ltos med par// dam tshig dang ni sdom pa bsrung*// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// nyin re bzhin yang bzla bar bya// gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa// kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur// dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te// zla ba re re bsrung ba ni// gnyis med gnyis med 'khor lo gnas// tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod// chang dang sha sogs gang ci'ang rung*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs// thams cad gnyis med par ni gnas// he ru ka dpal rab tu mchod// theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya// sems can la yang rgyab mi phyogs// 'khor ba dag kyang mi spong zhing*// mya ngan 'das la dgar mi rung*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la// khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya ste// phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang*// mtshan ma 'gong bar mi bgyid do// dam tshig rab bsrungs bsod nams kyis// tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur// bud med thams cad mthong ba na// g.yon nas lan gsum bskor bya zhing*// spyi bos phyag ni byas nas kyang*// lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab// bdag bu khyod nyid ma yin te// ji srid byang chub 'byung bar du// byang chub yan lag nu ma las// byung ba'i rang gi 'o mas skyongs// gnyis med ye shes dpyod ldan par// bslab pa blangs pa sngon 'gro bas// sgra sogs stong pa sngon 'gro ba'i// tshangs par spyod pa shin tu bsrungs// dam tshig de la rtag gnas te// de sngon 'gro ba sbas pa'i yid// spyod dang grol ba'i gnas 'dod pa'i// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub 'gyur//

de nas slob mas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de ltar thams cad bdag gis bgyid// bum pa'i dbang ngo*// de nas tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor brtsam/ maṇḍal/ 'khor ba'i 'dam du bying ba bdag /dpung gnyen khyed kyis bsgral du gsol// bdag ni rtsol chung skal dman zhing*// sangs rgyas chos ni rnam par spangs// kyai ston pa bla ma che// mgon po khyed kyis brtse bar mdzod// ces lan gsum/ slob dpon dpal he ru ka sangs rgyas thod pa sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon na thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ hūm̐ zhes sgrog cing skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa 'jigs shing khro ba'i bdag nyid stag gi pags pa'i na bza' mnabs pa/ mgo rlon bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya drug dang dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lngas brgyan cing*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog nag po can/ phyag rgya shes rab chen mo sna tshogs bde ma dkar mo zhal shin tu 'gyur ma/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pas 'jigs pa/ g.yas na ḍā ma ru 'chang zhing gri gug brdeg pa'i tshul/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba'i rgyun 'dzag pa yab la stob cing kha ṭwāṃ ga gru mo la gzer ba/ gcer bu rgyan dang bral ba/ skra grol ba/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis yab dang 'khril ba/ gnyis ka'ang 'od kyi 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i klong na bzhugs pa/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bsgoms pa dang mtshungs pa'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ slob ma la/ yid kyi lus ni brtan pa'i phyir// phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod// gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan// des na phyag rgyar rab tu grags// zhes brjod/ 'dod pa bzhi longs spyod pa'i mthar snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems phab/ rdo rje chen pos dbang bskur ba// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byed pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum che// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya//

zhes byin/ a ti su kha zhes brjod/ khams gsum po thams cad thabs dang shes rab gnyis su mi phyed pa'i ye shes kyi rol par gyur pa'i mos pa gyis/ de nas dbang gsum pa tshogs dkyil de nyid du bla ma dang phyag rgya la/ rnam par rtog pa mang po yis// g.yogs pa'i bag chags rab ldan pa// 'khor ba'i 'dam du bying ba bdag /mdzes ma khyod kyis skyob par mdzod// grags chen snying rje ldan pa yi// lha mo des ni zhi bar mdzod// slob dpon gyis/ slob ma dang rig ma gnyis ka mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma bcom 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon na thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ hūm̐ zhes sgrog cing skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa 'jigs shing khro ba'i bdag nyid stag gi pags pa'i na bza' mnabs pa/ mgo rlon bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya drug dang dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lngas brgyan cing*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog nag po can/ rig ma yum sna tshogs bde ma dkar mo zhal shin tu 'gyur ma/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pas 'jigs pa/ g.yas na ḍā ma ru 'chang zhing gri gug brdeg pa'i tshul/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba'i rgyun 'dzag pa yab la stob cing kha ṭwāṃ ga gru mo la gzer ba/ gcer bu rgyan dang bral ba/ skra grol ba/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis yab dang 'khril ba/ gnyis ka'ang 'od kyi 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i klong na bzhugs pa/ yab yum gnyis ka'i snying khar oṃ/ dpral bar hām̐/ spyi gtsug tu hai/ཾ dpung pa gnyis su hauṃ/ mig gnyis su heṃ/ gsang bar hoṃ/ lus thams cad du haṃ/ snying gar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje/ snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/
