dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ de nas rtsa'i 'khor lo las byang chub kyi sems 'dzag pa de las rnal 'byor ma rnams sna tshogs pa'i snying rje chen mo dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab pa/ gos sna tshogs gyon pa/ lang tshos brgyan pa'i rnal 'byor ma brgyad nam mkhar gnas pa bum pa byang chub sems kyis yongs su gang ba a mra'i shing los kha brgyan pa re thogs pa/ rab tu dwangs shing bzhad pa'i zhal gyis rgyal gyur he ru ka /zhes smra ba de mthong nas dbang bskur zhu ba'i phyir/ brtse ldan grags pa chen po yis// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbang bskur// 'khor ba'i 'dam du 'bying ba bdag /dbang bskur ba yis de sgrol zhig /ces gsol ba btab pas/ rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis rgyal gyur rgyal gyur zhes pas bcom ldan 'das la sogs pa la khrus gsol zhing phyi dang gsang bar bcas pa'i dbang bskur ba tsam gyis nam mkha'i ngos nas rnga'i sgra grag cing tsandan dang me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro// dbang bskur zin nas rnal 'byor ma rnams rtsa'i 'khor lo la thim/ yab la mi bskyod pa dang*/ yum la rdo rje sems pas dbu brgyan par gyur/

de nas phyag rgya de slob ma la/ gang gi shes rab ma gnyis pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ni mchod// 'di nyid la ni sangs rgyas bzhugs// gzhan dang dngos grub gtso bo dang*// snying rje ldan pa gzhan gang zhig /mkha' 'gro ma kun 'di la bzhugs// gsang ba phyi yi lnga dang ni// bdun dang bcu bzhir bshad pa dang*// gnyis ka gcig tu 'dus pa'o// zhes pas gtad/ yum sna tshogs bde ma'i padma la a/ he ru ka'i rdo rje la hūm̐ snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba cha bcu drug pa sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan par rgyas btab pa gsum pa shes rab ye shes so// de nas rnam pa thams cad nub pa rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bla ma dam pa'i drin gyis snying la sad par 'gyur te/ yul dang dbang po rnams ni mnyam du nub gyur pa// gang yang mngon dga' rgyal bas mdzes pa'i lus gcig pu// su zhig sad pa mkhas pa rnams kyi snying la 'dzin// dus mnyam 'char ba gang yin de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'i gsang ba bshad pa bzhi pa'o// de nas slob mas yon phul/ bla mas dbang gi phan yon bshad de/ mtshams med lnga ni byed pa dang*// rmongs gang ma rungs las byed dang*// skye ba dman gyur 'gro ba rnams// rdul tshon mthong bas grol bar 'gyur// dkyil 'khor dag tu mngon zhugs pas// gtsang ma'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur// shin tu sbyor ba'i sems kyis ni// skye 'dir dngos grub ma thob kyang*// skye gzhan srid bar dngos grub 'gyur// dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na// skye dang skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur// de yi skye ba bdun la ni// ma bsgrubs par ni dngos grub 'thob// gang yang sgom pa dang ldan zhing*// gal te dam tshig sdom la gnas// skye 'dir las dbang gis ma 'grub// re zhig dam tshig nyams pa la// dngos grub thob pa lta zhog gi /mi yi skye ba'ang rnyed par dka'// gang yang bla ma brgyud pa yi// rim 'ongs de nyid rig pa yi// sgrub pa po yis 'grub snyam 'ong*//

de nas slob ma mgo bor gdugs phub lag pa rdor dril 'dzin pas/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste// des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'don cing dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum byas shar phyogs nas phyag byas/ tshogs gong du ma byas na 'dir bya/ lha yi rnal 'byor gyis longs spyod pa dang*/ lhag ma sbyin pa rnams bya/ smon lam gdab bo// rjes kyi rim pa la/ mchod pa gsar du bsham/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ buddhā ka pā la pra wa ra satka ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ pa dyaṃ= añtsa ma ṇaṃ= oṃ badzra puṣpe pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ sogs/ shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pu dza khā hi/ zhes bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ oṃ buddhā ka pā la a hrīḥ.oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes nang mchod phul/ rdo rje dang ni padma 'dus shing bdud rtsis bde rgyas shing*// rim gyis yongs gyur sku can sems can don du gar byed pa// rdo rje lha mo'i rtsed mo rol pas rtser mdzod 'gro rmongs la// 'gro la mi dman kun dga' ster ba khyod la bdag 'dud do// zhes bstod/ (sgrub mchod kyi nub tha ma'i rjes chog la mdun bskyed skabs ltar mchod bstod rgyas par bya/) de nas yig brgya dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs bshags bya/ rdul tshon skabs/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// sogs brjod cing*/ nyin tha mar/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// sogs dang*/ ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs bya/ bdag bskyed bsdu ba gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar te/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa/

bdag gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ dur khrod brgyad bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ de gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa la/ de yang lha rnams la/ lha rnams gtso bo yab yum la/ gtso bo yab yum yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ la/ de yang 'od gsal du thim par gyur par mos pa la mnyam par bzhag go/ slar rang nyid he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ thugs kar oṃ/ dpral bar hām̐/ spyi gtsug tu hai/ཾ dpung pa gnyis su hauṃ/ mig gnyis su heṃ/ gsang bar hoṃ/ lus thams cad du haṃ/ snying gar hūm̐/ mgrin par āḥspyi bor oṃ yig gis mtshan par gyur/ ces go bgo/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /he ru ka dpal 'grub gyur nas// sogs dang*/ bsod nams 'di yis 'jig rten rnams// dga' ba'i bde ba kun rnyed nas// ye shes ldan pa'i sa gnas su// mi ldog par ni 'gro bar shog /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo'i lam 'di rnam par bsgoms las dge ba cher byung bas// 'khor ba'i 'khrul mang bcad nas 'gro 'di de yi dkyil 'khor du ni 'du bar shog /bdag ni thub pa 'di yi mtha' yas sku ni yun ring rnam par 'dzin byed cing*// srog chags so so la gzhol che ba'i bde ba spros pa 'jig pa 'dzin gyur cig/ ces sogs spyi dang khyad par gyi smon lam gdab bo// rdul tshon a kā ro 'i sngags brjod cing mtha' nas bsdus la gtso bo'i lha mtshan spyi bor bzhag chu bo chen por dor ro// sa der dris byug zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya'o// de ltar rje btsun mar lugs kyi sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga grub pa'i slob dpon chen po sa ra ha'i zhabs kyi gzhung ji lta ba bzhin padma dkar pos rgyal byed tshal du sbyar ba 'di yang phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar bas sems can thams cad bde ba chen po'i sa la 'jug par gyur cig slad nas dkyil chog 'di nyid dbang dang sgrub mchod sogs la 'jug pa bde ba'i ched du bklag chog tu bri bar byos zhes bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi gsung bskul spyi bor mchod nas 'khrul zhig brgyad ming pas 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas sogs mkhas grub dam pa rnams kyi gsung la sgo bstun nas bris pa 'dir ma rig nongs pa'i tshogs kun snying nas 'chags shing*/
